t: You're in Cadogan Square, a residential square in Knightsbridge named after Earl Cadogan. Most of the buildings are homes, though some are used for diplomatic and educational purposes. Several notable people were born here, among them the journalist Peregrine Worsthorne, who later edited The Sunday Telegraph, and Gwladys, Lady Delamere, who became the first female Mayor of Nairobi. The art historian and collector Sir Denis Mahon died here. He is credited with bringing Italian Baroque painters to the attention of English-speaking audiences, reversing the critical aversion that had prevailed since John Ruskin.
